highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews the Skia m154 engine update and compiler-generated XML API documentation.
highlights_body: HarfBuzzSharp bindings now follow the bundled native source, including a corrected Unicode combining-class enum name.

breaking.title: UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 renamed to CCC132
breaking.body: The corrected upstream HarfBuzz name is now CCC132 while its numeric value remains 132. Update source references from CCC133 to CCC132 before upgrading.

breaking.title: GlyphFlags.Defined is no longer exposed
breaking.body: The aggregate Defined mask is removed because it does not represent an independent option. Combine the concrete GlyphFlags values required by your application instead.

bullets.detail: The bundled renderer advances to m154 and includes the latest upstream bug and buffer-upload fixes.

bullets.lead: API documentation ships as compiler XML
bullets.detail: NuGet packages now include compiler-generated XML documentation sidecars, keeping API reference text adjacent to the managed assemblies.

contributor_summaries.azchohfi: Improved the HarfBuzzSharp native build warning handling

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 opened the 4.154 line with the Skia m154 engine update.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp bindings are generated from the DEPS-pinned native source and include corrected enum coverage while continuing to exclude unsupported callback-heavy APIs.

v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m154 engine update.
v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.body: It also begins shipping compiler-generated XML API documentation with the managed packages.
